summary: Join our training course on credit risk management in multi-asset portfolios. Learn strategies to mitigate risks and optimize your investment decisions today!
lede: Credit risk management in multi-asset portfolios helps credit and portfolio professionals assess risk across loans, bonds, and counterparty exposures. The course develops skills in exposure aggregation, borrower and issuer analysis, and expected-loss assessment, with practice in stress testing and portfolio reporting to support concentration monitoring and limit decisions.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who work with credit exposure, portfolio monitoring, counterparty analysis, and portfolio risk reporting in mixed-asset environments.
prerequisites: You should have a working understanding of basic credit analysis, financial statements, and portfolio terminology. Familiarity with ratios, cash flow statements, debt instruments, and risk reporting will help you move faster, but advanced quantitative programming is not required. This is an intermediate course, so you should be ready to work with exposure tables, rating movements, stress-testing scenarios, and portfolio dashboards. If your role involves credit limits, counterparty review, or portfolio monitoring, this course will be directly relevant.
